description: §14.8.9 — the canonical login: a protected hash is SELECTed and passed to `verifyPassword(pw, u.passwordHash)` server-side; only the boolean outcome and non-protected fields are returned. It compiles clean: no E-PROTECT-006 (the result of verifyPassword is a DERIVED value, the §14.8.9 bound) and no I-PROTECT-STRIP-001 (the row never reaches an egress, so nothing is stripped). CODES-ONLY: the impl1-ts runtime adapter evaluates the server bundle with `new Function`, which cannot load the bundle's `scrml:auth` stdlib import — the runtime proof (verifies against a real argon2id hash, returns `{ ok: true, user: { id, name } }`, never the hash) is EXECUTED in the source-test instead.
rationale: The S441 provenance flow (g-protected-column-escapes-redaction-as-scalar) must not false-positive on the canonical authentication shape. A scalar passed to a function the module does not define is a derived flow (§14.8.9 "a value computed from a protected column but of independent identity"), so `ok` is clean; `u.id` / `u.name` are non-protected. The row never reaches an egress sink, so I-PROTECT-STRIP-001 does not fire — the pre-S441 info fired here and claimed a strip that never happened.
